report: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2019 Prelims Paper-I
method: Every question re-read and answered independently; the printed key compared with the answer where the paper printed one; explanations rebuilt with a four-part standard (concept and justification, per-option reasoning tied to the option text, revision facts, takeaway). Corrections are recorded only where the evidence contradicts the key; items with more than one defensible answer or a defective stem are recorded as ambiguous instead of being forced to a single letter.
